implementation_binding: DICT/oracle interface changes will be hashed in immutable per-stage contracts before calls; this prediction file will not be edited

exposure.classification: retrospective for DIR, old G1 FULL and N256; newly computed interventions on already exposed development inputs are not independent confirmation

DIR.read_endpoints: engineering/full development counts, FER/CE and all strength results already read before this freeze
DIR.exact_first_human_read_time: not recoverable; do not claim blinding

N256.model: UWA integer-delay/full-fractional-Doppler explicit CPP physical G1

G1.coding: original frozen LDPC 2048 coded bits/1024 information bits
G1.model: untruncated physical CPP G1; G0 weights/scaling not substituted
G1.input_scope: same stored channel, data and noise; no new independent blocks

questions.direction: gamma=1 only where pilot-only Gram orthogonality is established
questions.target: actual K24 active supports, grouped by W2/W3/W4 and initial vs feedback design
questions.input: G=A^H A; E=||p+mu||^2; K; support; pilot/source identity
questions.definition: gamma=(E/K)tr(G^-1); rank-deficient designs reported separately, not pseudoinverted into a finite gamma
assumptions: orthogonality condition must be checked, not inferred from max coherence
questions.interval: report per-SNR distribution/range and channel-cluster paired bootstrap only for predeclared contrasts; algebraic identity does not need sampling CI
questions.falsification: valid stated premises with gamma outside dtype error bound refutes implementation/claimed application; failed premises are a recorded applicability failure
questions.five_percent_rule: not used as a cross-W guarantee or total-NMSE attribution
questions.novelty: known algebraic consequence; not counted as a new independent scientific prediction

questions.target: O2 final original FULL CE support and previous at t=9, every block at 7/8dB
questions.input: saved A/mu/previous/lambda/weights; true gS from Frobenius projection; true data/noise for oracle accounting
questions.secondary: normalized coefficient error and exact four-vector/six-cross-term decomposition
questions.group_definition: original FULL information-block FER; fixed now; subgroups are descriptive
assumptions: rebuild A using true already-scaled d
if prior enabled recompute its A-energy scaling

interval.unit: 32 independent channel clusters retaining both SNRs
interval.method: percentile Bonferroni simultaneous 95% for 2 SNR x absolute/ratio
interval.subgroup_intervals: 95% descriptive, subgroup labels fixed before intervention

questions.undefined: zero denominator makes ratio undefined, including any bootstrap draw; report count and no silent omission
questions.falsification: not a directional hypothesis; record positive/negative/inconclusive continuous effect without post-hoc direction
questions.causal_boundary: A/B/c and tail/noise projections change jointly; 50%/20% never label a dominant cause

questions.target: original DIR 3 penalties x 3 strengths offline and fixed .1 online
questions.input: original initial observed gains define delay-group centers; epsilon=.05; 128-point fixed quadrature; trace-matched precision
questions.prior_policy: reuse original build_precision only; no fit to true gains, tail or this batch's outcomes
assumptions: nominal zero means/independence must be labelled model assumptions, not selected-data truths
questions.identifiability_gap: conditional means and gain-disturbance cross covariance not identified by the supplied penalty; no supported prospective ranking exists
questions.interval: reuse original 32-channel paired DIR intervals, all strengths reported; no new receiver or strength reselection
questions.falsification: no pre-exposure ranking was frozen; report retrospective agreement/disagreement without a prediction-success label
questions.oracle: true-g/true-tail spectra and realized risks explicitly oracle-only, never deployable predictions

pilot_stage.pilot_formula: s_b[n]=sqrt(rho)exp(-j*pi*b*n^2/N); p_b=DAFT_c1,c2(s_b); b855 occupies only part of DAFT bins
pilot_stage.baseline: original first initialization/selection and fit, K24; original p0 arrays retained bitwise
pilot_stage.paired_observation: y_new=y_old+H_true*(p_new-p_old); H_true confined to simulator and oracle scoring
pilot_stage.primary: per-channel equal mean of linear complete-H NMSE at 7 and 8dB

bootstrap.unit: 32 channel clusters; both SNRs resampled together
bootstrap.method: percentile with Bonferroni four contrasts, simultaneous 95%

pilot_stage.promotion: both relevant CI upper limits <0 and both SNR point differences nonpositive; engineering/raw checks pass
pilot_stage.tie_break: smaller primary mean NMSE, exact tie W3
pilot_stage.stop: CI crossing zero is insufficient evidence; no extra roots, blocks or FER; no universal-null claim
pilot_stage.run_order: after fixed engineering blocks, seeded permutation of block/SNR/arm tasks; seed 202609150401

signal_constraints.normalization: component energies fixed; no per-block renormalization or clipping
signal_constraints.oversampling: also report 4x centered-DFT zero-pad interpolation, payload and CPP separately; native gate retains original definition

oracle_stage.O1_S: complete H_true p cancellation; detection with original final-S Frobenius projection; frozen terminal prior/noise/temperature
oracle_stage.O1_F: complete physical H in cancellation and detection; include every strictly nonzero matrix entry; same BP kernel/iterations; graph density and cost reported
oracle_stage.O2: t=9 original FULL S and previous; one true-data CE per point, zero BP/LDPC
oracle_stage.O3: preserve t0; only replace CE-local mu with true d at t=1 after ce(1), before x_total; original previous retained; mode=mean; legal t1 BP/checkpoint decode; normal feedback t>=2
oracle_stage.default_replay: reuse existing equality evidence when source changes cannot affect old route; otherwise only four engineering points

conditional_FER.strong_classical: original FULL plus zero-centered identity precision strength .1 (DirichletGainPrior kind=ridge); source and scale same as original DIR
conditional_FER.comparison: p*/W* against stored_p0/W*, same K24; original W2 is descriptive anchor

resource_contract.device: CPU; NVML mismatch verified in inventory
resource_contract.includes: setup, execution, failures, intermediates; internal CE/BP/LDPC itemized but not added again to F budget
resource_contract.memory: check MemAvailable and estimated peak before each stage; O1-F engineering must establish dense-graph feasibility before remaining 60 points
resource_contract.overrun: save failure/cost and stop affected stage; no automatic increase or alternate detector
resource_contract.no_extra_data: original G0/raw/failed runs/CONF/D_test immutable; no repeated completed experiments

future_confirmation: nontrivial predictive validation and method CONF are separate deferred scopes; no present candidate or claim is promoted by this file
publication_gate: no requirement to hit two predictions; algebra and null/inconclusive results do not establish publishability
